rsr AmencanTM T4#3020-1092226 BIk boy Lots: 1bMb,S1 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT(this“Agreement")is made as of the Q day of August, 2022 by and among (i) 411 VAN BRUNT LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address at 1481 47h Street, Brooklyn, New York 11219 (hereafter, the “411 VB Owner"), (i) BEARD STREET ACQUISITION LLC, a Delaware limited liability company having an address at 1481 47b Street, Brooklyn, New York 11219 (hereafter, the “BSA Owner"; 411 VB Owner and BSA Owner, together with their successors and assigns, collectively referred to herein as “Van Brunt Owner"); and (ii) 110 BEARD STREET, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company having an address at c/o LBA Realty, 3347 Michelson Drive, Suite 200, Irvine, California 92612 (hereafter, together with their successors and assigns, the “Richards Street Owner"; Van Brunt Owner and Richards Street Owner collectively referred to herein as the “Parties”and each individually as a“Party"). STATEMENTOFFACTS Van Brunt Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the County of Kings, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address 411 Van Brunt Street, Brooklyn, New York, designated as Lot 5, Lot 13 and Lot 1 in Block 604 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto (said being herein called the “Van Brunt Land;” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements, Alteration (as hereinafter defined) or Rebuilding (as hereinafter defined) thereof pernitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein called the “Van Brunt Building;” and the Van Brunt Land and the Van Brunt Building being herein collectively called the “Van Brunt Premises"). Richards Street Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the County of Kings, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address 236 Richards Street, Brooklyn, New York, designated as Lots 16, 46, and Lot 51 in Block 604 on the Tax Map and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto together with any future replacements,Alterations or Rebuilding thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein called the“Richards Street Building"; and the Richards Street Land and the Richards Street Building being herein collectively called the “Richards Street Premises"). Van Brunt Owner intends to construct either a new building on the Van Brunt Land or enlarge the Van Brunt Building such that in either case the Van Brunt Premises contains an amount of Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for commercial use that are in excess of the amount of commercial Floor Area Development Rights permitted to be constructed on the Van Brunt Premises under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if such Van Brunt Premises was considered a consolidated separate and independent zoning lot There are Floor Area Development Rights for commercial use appurtenant to the Richards Street Premises that are in excess of the Richards Street Development Rights (as hereinafter defined)andareavailablefortransferinaccordancewiththeZoningResolution.
